spec: TimeOfDayFee: a standalone fee module implementing the hook's fee-module interface. Constructor takes 24 hourly fee rates in pips (UTC hours 0-23), stored immutable; each must be within the policy bounds [10000, 30000] or the constructor reverts. The fee function reads , computes (timestamp / 3600) % 24 and returns that hour's rate; no storage writes, no external calls. A view schedule() returns all 24 rates so traders can read the full cycle. No owner, no setters, no payable code, no receive(). Gas per fee call stays well under DNAHook.MODULE_GAS_CAP 40_000. Tests: fuzz timestamps so every hour is hit and every fee is within bounds; gas cap test; constructor reverts on an out-of-bound rate; schedule() matches constructor input. Only proposed to the Safe, which alone may approve it. (a module build)
